Must-Know
1.Eco-friendly lead-free metal case
2.PoE models are ONLY PoE af/at based(PoE BT 90W standard is NOT supported)
3.The power comes in AC and DC input. For AC type, it has internal AC-DC converter
4.Power adapter is included in the price
But optical module is NOT included, need to purchase individually
For AC input models, there is a pair of mounting brackets in the packing box for rack mounting
